body:
Spectris stock is now tied to a private-equity-owned industrial business valued at USD 6.5 billion after the acquisition became effective on December 4, 2025. A September 2, 2026 announcement also named Sonal Arora as group head of mergers and acquisitions from November 2, 2026, according to MarketScreener.

The deal set a GBP 41.75 value

The transaction was structured as a cash acquisition by a KKR-backed vehicle. The consideration reached GBP 41.75 per share, comprising GBP 41.47 in cash and a 28 pence interim dividend, according to Multiples VC.

Shareholders approved the transaction on August 27, 2025, while a UK court sanctioned the scheme on December 2, 2025. The acquisition became effective two days later, with trading suspended and the London Stock Exchange delisting following on December 5, 2025.

Revenue supports the valuation math

Historical revenue stood at USD 1.7 billion at the time of the July 2025 transaction. Against the USD 6.5 billion valuation, the deal implied a 3.8x enterprise-value-to-revenue multiple and a 22.4x enterprise-value-to-EBITDA multiple, according to Multiples VC.

Spectris supplies precision measurement instruments, test equipment and software through its Spectris Scientific and Spectris Dynamics divisions. The business serves technically demanding applications in pharmaceuticals, electronics, automotive and aerospace.

Management adds an M&A role

The September 2, 2026 appointment gives Spectris an executive responsible for mergers and acquisitions as the private company continues its next phase. The announcement says Arora will join the executive leadership team on November 2, 2026, under CEO Constance Baroudel, according to MarketScreener.

Public trading gave way to ownership

The central investor takeaway is structural rather than a daily quote: the December 2025 transaction replaced public-market trading with private ownership. Spectris remains an industrial technology platform, but the GBP 41.75 per-share consideration is a historical transaction value rather than a current exchange price.
